translationResources.title: Sparkline
translationResources.description: A word-sized chart without axes or legend that shows the shape of a trend next to a number: in KPI cards, table cells or lists. Hover it to read a value.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: The same values as a smooth line, an area and bars; reference draws a dashed line at a value such as the average or a target.

kpi-cards.title: KPI cards
kpi-cards.description: Sparklines in Cards, under the figure and its change: the trend gives context to the number. Each card uses a type and a color that fit its metric.

table.title: In a table
table.description: A Sparkline per row in a Table column, with a fixed width and height; the color says whether the latency rises or falls.

watchlist.title: Stock watchlist
watchlist.description: A trading-app watchlist: each row has an intraday area sparkline colored by the change of the day, with a dashed reference at the previous close; prices use Intl.NumberFormat with each stock's currency.

inline.title: Inside a sentence
inline.description: Word-sized sparklines placed inline in text with a fixed width and height and display: inline-block, the original use of sparklines.

servers.title: Live server monitor
servers.description: Bar sparklines updated every second with a new CPU sample; the color and the tag turn red above the alert threshold.

hover-value.title: Hover readout
hover-value.description: onHover receives the hovered point (null when the pointer leaves): its index drives the big number and the date above, which fall back to the latest day. tooltip={false} hides the tooltip that the readout replaces.

step-goal.title: Daily goal
step-goal.description: Four weeks of steps as bars, the days reaching the goal colored through the color of their data point; reference draws the goal and renderTooltip shows the date and the share of the goal.

weather.title: Small multiples
weather.description: A Sparkline per city in a grid of Cards. Each one is scaled to its own range, so the warmest and coldest months are written above it; renderTooltip names the hovered month and reference marks 0 °C where the city freezes.

periods.title: Period switcher
periods.description: A RadioGroup picks the last 7, 30 or 90 days: the total, the change from the previous period and the color are computed from the same values, and reference marks the daily average of the period.

basic.title: KPI rows
basic.description: Word-sized area, bar and line charts next to the value of today; touch a sparkline to read a day in its tooltip.

SparklineProps.height: Height of the sparkline; numbers are pixels

SparklineConfig.type: How the values are drawn: "line", "area" or "bar"
SparklineConfig.color: Color (any CSS color); the first palette color by default
SparklineConfig.name: Name shown in the tooltip
SparklineConfig.reference: Draws a dashed reference line at this value (e.g. a target or the average)
SparklineConfig.format: Formats the value in the tooltip

reference.title: Target line and hover

props.valueName: Name of the value in the tooltip
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected
